title: Retail Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Tynimo Store is a fast fashion lifestyle brand offering 15+ categories of quirky and trendy products. The brand focuses on aesthetically designed items that appeal to modern, style-conscious shoppers. Tynimo Store showcases the art and culture of Indian artisans, bringing their work to a wider global audience. Team members contribute to a creative retail environment that values innovation, design, and cultural expression. Working at Tynimo Store means being part of a growing brand that blends fashion, lifestyle, and craftsmanship.
  
**Role Description**
The Retail Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based at the Tynimo Store in Shamshabad. The role involves welcoming customers, understanding their needs, and guiding them to suitable products across various lifestyle categories. Daily responsibilities include explaining product features, handling sales transactions, maintaining store displays, and ensuring stock is well-organized. The Retail Sales Executive responds to customer queries, manages returns or exchanges as per policy, and supports promotional activities within the store. This position also involves working closely with the store team to achieve sales targets and deliver a positive in-store experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Retail Sales and Sales skills, with the ability to meet or exceed store targets.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service and Relationship Building skills to create positive and repeat customer experiences.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for interacting with customers, peers, and supervisors.
* Basic numeracy and POS handling skills, with attention to accuracy in billing and cash management.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, work flexible shifts, and contribute to visual merchandising and store upkeep.
* Prior experience in fashion or lifestyle retail is an advantage, though motivated entry-level candidates may also be considered.

title: Retail Sales Lead- First Colony Mall
description:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.
  
  
**Opportunity Overview:**
At POP MART, we believe art has the power to inspire joy, spark imagination, and bring people together. As a Sales Lead, you'll play a key leadership role in creating exceptional customer experiences while supporting the daily operations of the store. As a trusted leader on the sales floor, you'll inspire your team, ensure operational excellence, and help bring the POP MART brand to life for every customer.
  
  
You'll serve as the Leader on Duty when the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager is unavailable, providing direction to the team, driving sales performance, and ensuring our stores consistently deliver the premium experience our collectors expect. From coaching associates and supporting visual merchandising to inventory management and new product launches, you'll help create an engaging environment where customers can discover the excitement of POP MART.
  
  
This position reports directly to the Store Manager.
  
  
**What you will achieve:**
**Leadership & Customer Experience**

* Lead by example to deliver an exceptional customer experience and inspire a customer-first culture.
* Serve as the Leader on Duty in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager, ensuring smooth daily operations.
* Coach, motivate, and support Sales Associates to achieve individual and store performance goals.
* Build meaningful relationships with customers by sharing the stories behind POP MART's artists, characters, Blind Boxes, MEGA Collections, and exclusive collaborations.
* Foster an energetic, inclusive, and engaging environment for customers and team members alike.

**Sales & Business Performance**

* Help achieve and exceed store sales goals and key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales, conversion, units per transaction (UPT), average transaction value (ATV), and customer engagement.
* Promote key product categories, limited-edition releases, and exclusive collections through knowledgeable product recommendations.
* Identify opportunities to improve store performance and communicate operational needs or business opportunities to store leadership.

**Store Operations**

* Execute opening and closing procedures while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with company policies.
* Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and visually compelling store environment.
* Accurately process customer transactions, returns, exchanges, and other POS activities.
* Support shipment processing, replenishment, stockroom organization, inventory accuracy, and cycle counts.
* Help protect company assets by following cash handling, safety, and loss prevention procedures.

**Visual Merchandising & Inventory**
*(Responsibilities may vary based on store volume and business needs.)*

* Execute POP MART visual merchandising standards, marketing directives, and promotional displays.
* Install new fixtures, marketing materials, decals, and planograms for product launches and seasonal campaigns.
* Refresh merchandising based on inventory levels, product sell-through, and business priorities.
* Support inventory audits, receiving, transfers, replenishment, and back-of-house organization.
* Partner with store leadership to maintain inventory accuracy and ensure merchandise is available for customers.

**Brand & Community**

* Serve as a knowledgeable brand ambassador by staying current on POP MART products, artists, characters, and company initiatives.
* Support in-store events, collector experiences, pop-up activations, conventions, new store openings, and other brand initiatives.
* Support Robo Shop operations and partner with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience where applicable.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other peak business periods.

**What you will need:**

* 1+ years of retail experience; previous leadership, keyholder, or supervisory experience preferred.
* Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and leading by example.
* Interest in designer toys, collectibles, art, anime, gaming, fashion, or pop culture is highly valued.
* Strong communication, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to motivate others while fostering a collaborative, inclusive team environment.
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable making decisions and prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret business metrics and use data to improve store performance.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.
* Basic computer and point-of-sale (POS) proficiency.
* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Must be at least 18 years of age.

**What We Offer**

* Market-competitive packages: 401k, health insurance, PTO, paid sick leave, and family leave.
* Growth opportunities: on-the-job training, leadership development, and stretch assignments to advance your career.
* Career development: opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as POP MART's North America business scales rapidly.

***\*The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It's not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, responsibilities and qualifications for this job.***
**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.
* Must be able to frequently bend, reach, stoop, kneel, and climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve merchandise.
* Must be able to regularly lift, carry, push, or move merchandise weighing up to 25 pounds.

**Pay Range Details**

title: Sales Operations (Hubspot) - Junior Executive
description:
Look for some one with 3+ years’ experience and should be well versed with HubSpot operations and admin activities. HubSpot certified will be an added advantage.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Sales Operations Executive to support our Sales and Marketing teams in driving consistent revenue growth and operational efficiency. The role involves managing sales processes, maintaining data accuracy, enabling reporting and insights, coordinating between sales and marketing functions, and ensuring seamless execution of sales enablement activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Sales Process & Support
  
  

* Support the sales team by streamlining processes, documentation, and pipeline management.
* Ensure timely creation and management of quotes, contracts, proposals, and order booking processes.
* Manage CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho) to maintain accurate customer and pipeline data.
* Track sales targets, achievements, and incentives for sales reps.

Data & Reporting
  
  

* Generate and analyse sales and marketing performance reports (leads, pipeline, conversions, revenue forecasts).
* Provide insights to management for decision-making and strategy optimization.
* Maintain dashboards to ensure leadership visibility of sales progress and marketing ROI.

Sales & Marketing Alignment
  
  

* Coordinate with marketing to track lead generation, campaigns, and handover of marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) to sales.
* Assist in campaign execution follow-ups with sales teams to increase conversion.
* Maintain central repositories of sales and marketing assets (collaterals, presentations, templates).

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Optimize workflows and tools for efficiency and accuracy.
* Assist in onboarding, training, and supporting new sales team members with tools/systems.
* Support forecasting, territory alignment, and sales incentive programs.
* Act as point of contact between sales, marketing, and cross-functional teams such as finance, operations, and customer success.

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho or similar).
* Excellent proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets and reporting dashboards (Power BI, Tableau ideal).
* Effective communication and coordination skills across teams.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven.
* Problem-solving mindset and ability to suggest improvements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Operations, or related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Support, or related roles.
* Experience working with sales/marketing automation tools is a plus.
* Prior exposure to IT, SaaS, or B2B industries preferred (but not mandatory).

What We Offer
  
  

* An opportunity to work closely with leadership in a high-growth environment.
* Exposure to both Sales and Marketing strategy execution.
* Budget Upto: 5LPA

title: Sales Staff
description:
**Company Description** 
 Greentek India Limited is an integrated solar engineering company with roots in the solar sector since 1997 and incorporation in 2007\. The organization designs, manufactures, executes, monitors, and maintains solar solutions ranging from residential rooftops to institutional hot\-water plants and utility\-scale projects. Its EPC business spans residential rooftop projects under PM Surya Ghar, commercial and industrial plants under CAPEX, OPEX and PPA models, operations and maintenance services, and Adani Solar module supply as an authorized channel partner. Greentek operates a BIS\-licensed manufacturing unit in Shabaspalle, Medak, producing solar flat plate collectors, absorber fins and storage tanks, and is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified and MNRE approved. The company serves clients such as L\&T, Indian Oil, Wipro, Shapoorji Pallonji, SECI, CPWD, ESIC, and leading educational and medical institutes, with operations across India, UAE and Kenya.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Sales Staff role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Secunderābād. The role involves identifying and qualifying potential customers, promoting Greentek’s solar products and EPC services, and managing the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing. Daily activities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with technical and operations teams to ensure accurate solutions, and maintaining detailed records of interactions in CRM or internal systems. The Sales Staff will be expected to meet sales targets, follow up on inquiries, participate in marketing or promotional events, and provide ongoing account management and support to existing clients. The role also includes staying updated on solar industry trends, government schemes and policies, and communicating these effectively to customers.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong sales, negotiation, and persuasion skills, with the ability to achieve and exceed sales targets.
* Customer relationship management abilities, including lead follow\-up, account management, and after\-sales service.
* Knowledge of solar energy solutions, EPC projects, and basic technical understanding of solar systems (training support may be provided).
* Effective communication and presentation skills in English and relevant local languages.
* Good organizational, planning, and time\-management skills to handle multiple prospects and projects.
* Comfort with using MS Office, CRM tools, and digital communication platforms for reporting and coordination.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field preferred; relevant experience in solar or industrial sales is an advantage.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Secunderābād and travel to client locations as required.

title: Sales Manager
description:

The role requires deep expertise in Zoho ecosystem sales, strong pipeline management, CXO\-level engagement, and the ability to drive structured revenue growth through CRM\-driven sales processes.
   




 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in SaaS solution selling, account expansion, proposal preparation, and digital transformation consulting across multiple Zoho applications.
   

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Sales Strategy \& Revenue Growth
   

  

  

* Develop and execute sales strategies to drive Zoho solution revenue
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets
* Expand business through new logo acquisition and key account growth
* Drive up selling and cross\-selling across the Zoho ecosystem


 Lead \& Pipeline Management
   

  

  

* Oversee structured lead qualification using BANT framework
* Ensure proper pipeline creation, deal staging, and forecasting accuracy
* Maintain strong conversion ratios across the sales funnel
* Prevent lead leakage through disciplined CRM management


 Proposal Development \& Commercial Structuring
   

  

  

* Prepare detailed and customized business proposals and commercial quotes

* Collaborate with Pre\-Sales and Delivery teams for technical and functional inputs
* Present proposals confidently to decision\-makers and stakeholders
* Negotiate commercials and close deals effectively


 Enterprise \& CXO Engagement
   

  

  

* Engage with CXOs, IT Heads, CFOs, CHROs, and decision\-makers

 Deal Closure \& Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

  

* Manage the complete sales lifecycle from prospecting to closure

 Customer Retention \& Account Growth
   

  

  

* Drive long\-term customer relationships and key account retention
* Support renewals, expansions, and digital transformation initiatives
* Identify new opportunities within existing customer base


 CRM Discipline \& Reporting
   

  

  

* Ensure accurate CRM updates and opportunity tracking
* Maintain data hygiene across leads, deals, and accounts
* Provide regular sales forecasts, reports, and pipeline insights
* Adhere to structured sales workflows and organizational processes
* 


 Requirements
   

  

* 6–10 years of experience in B2B SaaS / Zoho solution sales

* Proven track record of revenue growth and key account retention
* Strong experience in proposal creation, commercial structuring, and negotiation
* Experience in enterprise solution selling and digital transformation consulting
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mindset with structured, process\-driven approach

 Luminara Legacy Pvt. Ltd. specializes in high\-quality seeds, pesticides, micro\-nutrients, and sustainable farming solutions. The company is dedicated to empowering farmers through reliable products and practical support that enhance crop yield and resilience. By focusing on agricultural innovation, Luminara Legacy aims to improve productivity and long\-term soil health. Team members contribute to a mission that supports rural communities and a more prosperous, sustainable agricultural future for all.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Tele Caller role based in Kompally. The Tele Caller will make outbound calls to farmers, distributors, and retail partners to share product information, explain benefits, and respond to basic queries about seeds, pesticides, and micro\-nutrients. The role involves following call scripts, maintaining accurate records of conversations in the system, and updating customer details after each interaction. The Tele Caller will also support lead generation, schedule follow\-up calls or visits for the sales team, and provide feedback on customer needs and market trends. Collaboration with sales, marketing, and customer support teams is expected to ensure consistent communication and a positive customer experience.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong verbal communication skills in a professional phone environment, with clear and respectful customer interaction.
* Basic knowledge or interest in agriculture, seeds, pesticides, and micro\-nutrients, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Ability to maintain accurate call logs, update customer databases, and follow structured call scripts or guidelines.
* Sales or customer service aptitude, including handling objections, identifying opportunities, and building rapport over the phone.
* Comfort working with basic computer tools and CRM or call\-tracking software.
* Ability to work on\-site in
 
 Kompally
 
 , manage time effectively, and meet daily or weekly call and follow\-up targets.
* Prior experience in telecalling, customer support, or inside sales is an advantage but not mandatory.
